chitchat: The guest checks the countdown monitor and adjusts a collar that was already fine.
"When they call me back out there, you watch — it's going to turn around tonight."
description: Tonight's booked guest, marooned in the booth in stage makeup an inch too orange, one leg jittering under the warm lamp. Handsome in the way of a face you half-recognise from a scandal you can't quite place, radiating the specific desperation of someone who needs this segment to go well more than the audience ever could.

bye.text: "Watch the couch. You'll see." They turn back to the countdown, leg jittering, rehearsing a laugh.

career.text: "The whole— the arc, you know? The comeback arc." They wave a hand at the countdown monitor like it owes them money. "One good couch segment and the feeds pick it up and suddenly everyone remembers they liked you. That's all it takes. One good night." The confidence is doing a lot of work and knows it.

nervous.text: They laugh, too quick. "Nervous? No. It's just warm in here." A beat, and the mask slips a half-inch. "...You think the gallery still claps for people like me? On the light, I mean. When the sign tells them to." They don't wait for an answer they'd believe.

root.text: The guest brightens the instant you look their way, hand already out. "You saw the last one? No? Doesn't matter — tonight's the one that turns it around. I can feel it. They only put you in the booth when they're serious about you." The leg keeps jittering.

clothing_layers: a too-sharp checked jacket with a crew mic clipped to the lapel
a shirt sweated through under the makeup lamp
pressed trousers, dress socks, and boxers

name: Dex Marrow
